scope: 十五个地域各一个普通有偿服务班的细粒度登记：名称（中英）、经办人、职能、有限库存、档位门禁与边界。落实城市页既有规则「每城只新设一个普通有偿服务班，一批案件结束前不刷新库存」。
shared_rules: 每城仅此一班；不刷新成玩家跑腿任务，不与原生商店/银行/海关/官署重叠，不冒称原角色官署授权。
一批案件结束前不刷新库存；补货只影响本班被明列的渠道，不补满原生商人。
库存为设计上限：不无限、不复制唯一物、同款同物只占一次；缺料如实待办。
档位门禁只改范围与便利：−2关闭、−1限范围、0基础、+1一处小便利（预约位/优先时段/单渠道≤15%折扣）、+2预约与转介；不越本人授权。
谈崩、停工、负声望不关闭双向回程；保基础替代渠道与安全回程。
价格与数值待实机校准；本表只给设计口径，不写冠数。

services.name_cn: 小批货样核验与运单誊写班
services.name_en: Small-Lot Sample Check and Waybill Desk
services.function_cn: 为小批港货核对样扣、布样与纸样并誊写普通运单；不触原银行、海关与货栈账。
services.function_en: Checks small harbour lots (buckles, cloth, paper) and copies ordinary waybills; never touches the bank, customs or warehouse ledgers.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先时段；+2：约一次旁听位（不代投票）。
services.refresh_cn: 一批案件结束前不刷新样料；样料缺额如实待办。
services.bounds_cn: 不借原督工/银行名义；不代写欠据；负声望保港口基本通行。
services.bounds_en: No guild or bank authority; no debt notes; low bands keep basic harbour passage.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority time slot; +2: one listening seat by appointment (no proxy voting).
services.refresh_en: Samples do not restock before a case batch closes; shortfalls stay listed as pending.

services.name_cn: 网具修补与短泊登记班
services.function_cn: 按实料补网、登记短泊次序与回迁抄名；不改军需优先与租住条件。
services.function_en: Mends nets from real stock, logs short-berth order and returning names; never changes military priority or tenancy.
services.convenience_cn: +1：预约补网时段；+2：约一次棚簿只读。
services.refresh_cn: 补网料按批补；不因日常完成强制刷新。
services.bounds_cn: 不代签租契；负声望不赶人出屋、不收回已付租。
services.bounds_en: No lease signing; negative bands neither evict nor reclaim settled rent.
services.convenience_en: +1: booked net-mending slot; +2: one read-only look at the shed ledger.
services.refresh_en: Mending stock is replenished by batch; daily completions do not force a restock.

services.function_cn: 修筐按柳条实料、校准量斗与谷尺；不改地契、收成与领主关系。
services.function_en: Repairs baskets from real willow and calibrates measures; never touches deeds, harvests or lordship.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先修补位；+2：约一次留种柜只读。
services.refresh_cn: 柳条按批补；不制造无风险采集循环。
services.bounds_cn: 不替人写让地文书；负声望不锁磨坊与粮车。
services.bounds_en: No land waivers; negative bands never lock the mill or grain carts.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority repair slot; +2: one read-only look at the seed cabinet.
services.refresh_en: Willow is replenished by batch; no risk-free gathering loop is created.

services.function_cn: 按实料箍桶、代存私桶并按牌管理酒位；不改税、不给独家配方。
services.function_en: Hoops casks from real stock and keeps private racks by tag; never changes taxes or hands out recipes.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先桶检；+2：约一次空位代存（不可售）。
services.refresh_cn: 箍铁按批补；代存位占满即止。
services.bounds_cn: 配方与代管另授权；负声望不砸桶、不锁酒窖。
services.bounds_en: Recipes and custody need separate leave; negative bands never smash barrels or lock cellars.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority cask check; +2: one storage slot by appointment (not for sale).
services.refresh_en: Hoop iron is replenished by batch; storage stops once the slots are full.

services.function_cn: 返修衬布、按旧量样做有限量装与试穿；不改军需与宗教史。
services.function_en: Repairs linings and does limited fitting to old measures; never touches armory or religious history.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先返修位；+2：约一次挂墙工具位（仍限借）。
services.refresh_cn: 衬布按批补；不炫工艺配方。
services.bounds_cn: 不代署名、不转卖赠礼；负声望不拒基础修理。
services.bounds_en: No proxy signatures, no resale of gifts; negative bands keep basic repairs.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority repair slot; +2: one wall-tool slot by appointment (loan only).
services.refresh_en: Lining cloth is replenished by batch; craft formulas are not shown off.

services.name_cn: 炭料过秤与炉位预约班
services.function_cn: 炭料按份过秤、登记炉位预约；赎金与工资分账，不改王廷辖属。
services.function_en: Weighs charcoal by share and books forge slots; ransom and wages stay in separate columns.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先过秤；+2：约一次炉位（不插队、不免料）。
services.refresh_cn: 炭份按批补；炉位占满即止。
services.bounds_cn: 不折赎金为积分、不许无限代工；负声望不熄公用炉。
services.bounds_en: No ransom-as-points, no endless commission; negative bands never douse the public forge.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority weighing; +2: one forge slot by appointment (no queue-jumping, no free stock).
services.refresh_en: Charcoal shares are replenished by batch; forge slots stop once full.

services.name_cn: 素面染整与织期登记班
services.function_cn: 素面染整、登记织期与样品适用性检查；不炫配方、不改军镇印象。
services.function_en: Dyes plain cloth, logs loom queues and checks sample wearability; never exposes recipes.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先检查；+2：约一次素面优先匹（实价、可拒卖）。
services.refresh_cn: 染样按批补；素面优先限一匹。
services.bounds_cn: 不无限供货、不追回已售布；负声望不剪断织机。
services.bounds_en: No endless supply, no reclaiming sold cloth; negative bands never cut looms.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority inspection; +2: one plain-cloth priority bolt by appointment (real price, may be refused).
services.refresh_en: Dye samples are replenished by batch; plain priority is limited to one bolt.

services.name_cn: 旧物寄存与凭据对照班
services.function_cn: 寄存旧物、对照凭据与柜号；不改族史、不判归属。
services.function_en: Keeps old objects and checks credentials against cabinet numbers; never judges lineage or ownership.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先对照；+2：约一次留灯（不赊宿资）。
services.refresh_cn: 寄存格占满即止；对照不复制真凭。
services.bounds_cn: 空栏就是空栏；负声望不夺旧寄存物。
services.bounds_en: Empty columns stay empty; negative bands never seize old deposits.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority credential check; +2: one lamp kept by appointment (no credit on lodging).
services.refresh_en: Deposit slots stop once full; checks never copy a genuine credential.

services.name_cn: 旧材检尺与工班登记班
services.function_cn: 旧材检尺、登记工班与装运范围；不恢复全线出口。
services.function_en: Scales old timber and logs crews and shipping scopes; never revives the old export line.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先检尺；+2：约一次旧道同行（不代巡）。
services.refresh_cn: 旧材按批补；不擅拆仍住人的梁。
services.bounds_cn: 不代公开弓艺；负声望不退已运木材、不封村。
services.bounds_en: No bow-craft disclosure; negative bands never reclaim delivered timber.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority scaling; +2: one walk along the old road by appointment (no patrol duty).
services.refresh_en: Old timber is replenished by batch; beams still housing people are never pulled.

services.name_cn: 井段检查与停班簿代办班
services.function_cn: 独立检查本段、代办停班簿抄录与工时核对；不减安全规程。
services.function_en: Independent section checks, stop-book copying and hour verification; safety rules stay whole.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先检查；+2：约一次停班簿只读。
services.refresh_cn: 检查按案排期；簿抄不补造缺页。
services.bounds_cn: 不许无票下井；负声望不填井、不夺已发工钱。
services.bounds_en: No unticketed descent; negative bands never seal pits or claw back wages.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority check; +2: one read-only look at the stop book.
services.refresh_en: Checks are scheduled per case; book copies never fill in missing pages.

services.name_cn: 纪念物修复与铭牌拓印班
services.function_cn: 修复纪念物、拓印铭牌并按登记管理副件；不改碑文、不发纪念章资格。
services.function_en: Repairs memorials and rubs plaques by registry; never edits inscriptions or grants medals.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先修复；+2：约一次静铃默记（不发章）。
services.refresh_cn: 副件按登记一次性、不刷新；拓印不复制真章。
services.bounds_cn: 旧兽已死不再卖第二遍；负声望不挖旧碑。
services.bounds_en: The old beast stays dead; negative bands never dig old stele.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority repair; +2: one silent-bell memorial by appointment (no badge issued).
services.refresh_en: Copies are one-off per registration and never restock; rubbings never copy a real seal.

services.name_cn: 量粮复核与旁路石检班
services.name_en: Grain Re-Measure and Bypass Stone Check Desk
services.function_cn: 失粮复量、旁路石段检查与点名对照；不替代印章与点名。
services.function_en: Re-measures lost grain, checks bypass stone and compares roll calls; never replaces seals or roll calls.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先复量；+2：约一次副榜只读（不代点）。
services.refresh_cn: 复量按案排期；对照不合并两册。
services.bounds_cn: 低信任保通行；负声望不押人、不扣合法货。
services.bounds_en: Low trust keeps passage; negative bands never jail or seize lawful goods.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority re-measure; +2: one read-only look at the secondary roll (no proxy counting).
services.refresh_en: Re-measures are scheduled per case; checks never merge the two ledgers.

services.name_cn: 普通护理班与净水配给登记
services.name_en: Ordinary Care Shift and Water-Ration Desk
services.function_cn: 当班普通护理、净水配给登记与班次分配；研究另问，不捆在物资后面。
services.function_en: Ordinary care shifts, water-ration logs and shift allotment; research is asked separately.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先登记；+2：约一次班次分配列席（只读、不代签）。
services.refresh_cn: 物资按批补；班次按实际人手，不造免费无限物。
services.bounds_cn: 护理不是研究许可；负声望不停基本水、不赶轻患者。
services.bounds_en: Care is not research consent; negative bands never cut basic water.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority registration; +2: one shift-allocation seat by appointment (read-only, no signing for others).
services.refresh_en: Supplies are replenished by batch; shifts follow actual hands and never create free endless goods.

services.name_cn: 限载验修与停牌代办班
services.function_cn: 本段限载验修、停牌代办与读数抄录核对；不授全山安全或NE5。
services.function_en: Section load-limited repair, stop-board handling and reading verification; never certifies the mountain.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先验段；+2：约一次固定槽读数只读。
services.refresh_cn: 验段按案排期；牌抄不复制核验。
services.bounds_cn: 钱不是梁没裂的证明；负声望不停外道、不清旧记录。
services.bounds_en: Money never proves an uncracked beam; negative bands never close outer paths.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority section check; +2: one read-only look at the fixed-slot readings.
services.refresh_en: Section checks are scheduled per case; board copies never replicate a verification.

services.name_cn: 冷窗抄本阅读与校验班
services.function_cn: 在馆阅读已登记抄本、做有限校验与分栏标注；书不出馆、不代署名。
services.function_en: On-site reading of logged copies, limited verification and column notes; books never leave.
services.convenience_cn: +1：优先阅览位；+2：约一次已登记抄本先看（不带出）。
services.refresh_cn: 阅览按班排期、不刷新；校验不补造缺页。
services.bounds_cn: 留下知识不留下压人的人；负声望不烧书、不逐合法住户。
services.bounds_en: Knowledge stays, oppression does not; negative bands never burn books.
services.convenience_en: +1: priority reading seat; +2: one registered copy by appointment (not taken out).
services.refresh_en: Reading is scheduled per shift and never restocks; verification never fills in missing pages.
